name: Fuzzing

  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  property-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5

        python-version: '3.10'
        
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -e .
        pip install atheris
        
    - name: Run Atheris fuzzing
      run: |
        timeout 60s python -m fuzzing.atheris_fuzz
      continue-on-error: true
